en.title: Vegan Mapo Tofu
en.summary: Tofu and finely chopped mushrooms in a spicy Sichuan-style sauce. A simplified plant-based version without meat or fish stock.
en.imageAlt: AI food photograph: Vegan Mapo Tofu
en.rightsNote: Independently developed home vegan version; quantities and method are not a transcription of the linked recipe. No animal ingredients. Original AI photograph; editorial approval requested by the user. Use vegan-labelled packaged ingredients.
steps: Soak dried mushrooms in 300 ml hot water for 15 minutes. Strain the liquid and chop mushrooms.
Brown finely chopped button mushrooms in oil for 8 minutes, then add soaked mushrooms.
Add garlic, ginger and doubanjiang. Stir for 1 minute, then add mushroom liquid and soy sauce.
Add tofu cubes and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir in cornstarch mixed with the remaining 50 ml water and cook for 1 minute.
Finish with ground Sichuan pepper and spring onions. Check that the paste contains no fish or shellfish.

Planinari: iz visokog planka naizmjenično približavaj koljena prsima, bez ljuljanja kukova.
Plank na podlakticama: laktovi ispod ramena, tijelo u ravnoj liniji, diši; po potrebi osloni koljena.
Diši tokom rada i daj prednost kontrolisanom pokretu. Uzmi dodatni odmor kada treba; tada se ukupno trajanje produžava. Prekini ako se pojavi bol ili vrtoglavica.

en.title: Plank challenge — eight minutes of work
en.summary: Two sets of eight thirty-second intervals provide eight minutes of work. A thirty-second break between sets makes 8:30 in total; the card rounds this up to nine minutes.

steps: Warm up before timing. Breathe continuously; rest when alignment deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness.
Each following interval lasts thirty seconds.
High plank: alternate forward single-arm reaches.
Side plank: lower and lift hips; right, then left, in separate intervals.
High plank: alternate opposite arm-and-leg raises.
Side plank: bring the upper elbow and knee together; right, then left, in separate intervals.
Reverse plank: hold the hips lifted with control.
High plank: alternate knees toward opposite elbows.
Rest thirty seconds, then repeat the eight intervals. The source title says eight minutes; including this break gives 8:30 without extra pauses.
en.recommendationReason: For someone who already controls a basic plank and wants a varied short routine. Learn each variation first and adapt your support to your ability.

steps: Warm up and check your push-up control first. If needed, choose an easier variation with a coach and record the modification.
Play Flower by Moby through your own authorized service. Audio is not included in the package.
Move to the top of the push-up on the rising cue and to the bottom on the lowering cue.

en.title: 5k Run — five kilometres for time
en.summary: Run 5 km and record total elapsed time. Choose a measured route and a pace suited to your fitness. The thirty-minute card duration is an editorial planning estimate, not a required result or time cap.
en.imageAlt: Original illustration of an adult running along a park path.
en.rightsNote: Original summary and translation; AI illustration. The WODwell protocol was unavailable during preparation. Protocol corroborated at https://www.crossfit.com/workout/2018/05/02 Duration is an editorial estimate. Human review of facts, translations and rights is required.
steps: Choose a safe measured 5 km route. On a standard 400 m track this is twelve and a half laps in lane one.
Warm up with gentle movement before the timed effort. Warm-up is not part of your score.
Start the clock and run 5 km at a pace you can control. Any breaks count toward elapsed time.
Stop the clock after the full 5 km and record time, route and conditions. Note any combination of walking and running with your result.
Finish with easy walking. The thirty-minute estimate is not a time cap; adapt your pace and stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: A simple way to track your own running progress over a consistent distance. Compare attempts on similar surfaces and in similar conditions without needing a personal best every time.
equipment: Measured 5 km route or athletics track

steps: Odaberi sigurnu izmjerenu rutu od 5 km. Na standardnoj stazi od 400 m to je 12,5 krugova u prvoj stazi.

en.title: Falafel Wrap
en.summary: Crisp chickpea falafel in flatbread with fresh vegetables and tahini sauce. Plan ahead: dried chickpeas need overnight soaking, excluded from the stated preparation time.
en.imageAlt: Illustration of Falafel Wrap
en.sourceLabel: Original recipe draft from user brief
en.rightsNote: Original untested home-recipe draft inspired by the user-provided dish list; not extracted from the named websites. Quantities, timings, safety and allergens require human review. Image is an original AI editorial illustration.
steps: The day before, soak dried chickpeas in plenty of cold water in the refrigerator for 18–24 hours. Drain and rinse. The stated 90 minutes excludes overnight soaking. Do not substitute cooked chickpeas in this version.
Pulse chickpeas with onion, garlic, parsley, cumin, coriander and salt into a fine, grainy mixture, not a smooth paste. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Stir in baking powder. Form small balls, around 3 cm across. Test one first; if the mixture crumbles, pulse it finer rather than adding large amounts of flour.
Heat frying oil to about 175°C in a suitable deep pan, leaving plenty of room. Fry small batches for around 5–7 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Never leave hot oil unattended.
Mix tahini, lemon and sauce water until smooth. Season to taste. Wash and slice the vegetables.
Drain falafel on absorbent paper. Serve in warmed flatbread with vegetables and tahini sauce. The 700 ml oil is frying medium, not the amount consumed.

steps: Dan ranije suhi slanutak namoči u mnogo hladne vode i drži u frižideru 18–24 sata. Ocijedi i isperi. Navedenih 90 minuta ne uključuje noćno namakanje. U ovoj verziji ne koristi kuhani slanutak.
Slanutak s lukom, bijelim lukom, peršunom, kuminom, korijanderom i soli usitni do sitne zrnaste smjese, ne glatke paste. Drži u frižideru 30 minuta.
Umiješaj prašak za pecivo i oblikuj kuglice prečnika oko 3 cm. Prvo isprobaj jednu; ako se smjesa raspada, dodatno je usitni umjesto dodavanja mnogo brašna.

Ulje za prženje zagrij na oko 175°C u odgovarajućoj dubljoj posudi, ostavljajući dovoljno prostora. Prži male ture oko 5–7 minuta uz okretanje, do zlatne boje i potpuno pečene unutrašnjosti. Vruće ulje nikada ne ostavljaj bez nadzora.
Tahini, limun i vodu za umak izmiješaj do glatke teksture i začini. Operi i nareži povrće.

en.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
en.summary: Chicken marinated in yogurt and spices, seared and simmered in a creamy tomato sauce, served with basmati rice. Allow at least three extra hours for marinating; this is not included in the listed preparation time.
en.imageAlt: Stylized illustration of chicken tikka masala in an orange-red sauce with basmati rice and fresh coriander.
en.sourceLabel: RecipeTin Eats – Chicken Tikka Masala (source recipe)
en.rightsNote: The user supplied a draft based on a RecipeTin Eats recipe. Recipe text and translations were edited for RANDOM; no original photography was reused. Review the facts, adaptations and rights to the new illustration before publication.
steps: Cut the chicken into evenly sized pieces, around 3 cm each.

Mix a marinade with the yogurt, six crushed garlic cloves, one tablespoon of ginger, one teaspoon of garam masala, one teaspoon each of cumin, coriander and paprika, lemon juice, a little oil, salt and pepper. Coat the chicken thoroughly.
Cover and refrigerate the chicken for at least three hours; overnight marinating is another option.
Heat a wide frying pan with a little oil over high heat. Sear the chicken in two batches until browned in places. It will finish cooking in the sauce.
In a deeper pan, heat the remaining oil and 30 g of butter. Add the finely chopped onion and remaining ginger. Cook for a few minutes until softened.
Add the remaining garlic and the rest of the paprika, turmeric, garam masala, cumin, coriander, cardamom and cayenne pepper. Stir briefly until aromatic, without burning the spices.
Stir in the tomato passata and water. Lower the heat, cover and simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Blend the sauce carefully until smooth. If using a jug blender, allow it to cool to a safe temperature first.
Return the sauce to the pan. Stir in the cream, sugar and remaining 50 g of butter.
Add the seared chicken and simmer gently until thoroughly cooked. Check that the thickest piece has reached at least 74°C internally.

bs.title: Piletina tikka masala
bs.summary: Komadi piletine marinirani u jogurtu i začinima, zapečeni pa kuhani u kremastom umaku od paradajza. Poslužuju se uz basmati rižu. Mariniranje od najmanje tri sata nije uključeno u navedeno aktivno vrijeme.

steps: Piletinu očisti i izreži na približno jednake komade veličine oko tri centimetra.

Pripremi marinadu od jogurta, šest usitnjenih čehni bijelog luka, jedne kašike đumbira, jedne kašičice garam masale, po jedne kašičice kumina, korijandera i slatke paprike, limunovog soka, malo ulja, soli i bibera. Dodaj piletinu i dobro promiješaj.
Pokrij posudu i ostavi piletinu u frižideru najmanje tri sata. Za intenzivniji ukus može stajati preko noći.

Zagrij široku tavu na visokoj temperaturi s malo ulja. Piletinu peci u dvije ture dok površina ne dobije tamnije zapečene dijelove. U ovoj fazi meso ne mora biti potpuno pečeno jer će se kasnije kuhati u umaku.
U dubljoj tavi zagrij preostalo ulje i 30 grama maslaca. Dodaj sitno nasjeckani luk i preostali đumbir. Dinstaj nekoliko minuta dok luk ne omekša.
Dodaj preostali bijeli luk, ostatak slatke paprike, kurkumu, garam masalu, kumin, korijander, kardamom i kajensku papriku. Kratko zagrij začine uz miješanje da oslobode aromu, pazeći da ne zagore.
Umiješaj pasirani paradajz i vodu. Smanji temperaturu, poklopi i kuhaj oko petnaest minuta, povremeno miješajući.
Umak pažljivo usitni štapnim mikserom dok ne postane gladak. Ako koristiš samostojeći blender, prvo ga ohladi na sigurnu temperaturu.
Vrati umak u tavu, dodaj vrhnje, šećer i preostalih 50 grama maslaca. Promiješaj dok se sastojci ne sjedine.
Dodaj prethodno zapečenu piletinu i nastavi lagano kuhati dok meso ne bude potpuno termički obrađeno. Provjeri da najdeblji komad dostigne unutrašnju temperaturu od najmanje 74 °C.
Posebno skuhaj basmati rižu prema uputstvu na pakovanju. Posluži toplu piletinu s umakom preko riže. Po želji ukrasi svježim listovima korijandera.

en.title: Shish Tawook
en.summary: Yogurt-marinated chicken skewers with lemon and garlic. This home version includes refrigerated marinating time and a temperature check.
en.imageAlt: Illustration of Shish Tawook
en.sourceLabel: Original recipe draft from user brief
en.rightsNote: Original untested home-recipe draft inspired by the user-provided dish list; not extracted from the named websites. Quantities, timings, safety and allergens require human review. Image is an original AI editorial illustration.
steps: Cut the chicken into even cubes. Mix yogurt, lemon juice, oil, crushed garlic, paprika, tomato paste and salt.
Coat the chicken and refrigerate for at least 45 minutes. Longer marinating adds to the total time.
Thread onto metal skewers. If using wooden skewers, soak them first and follow the manufacturer’s instructions.
Cook on a hot grill or griddle, turning, for about 12–18 minutes. Check several thick pieces reach at least 74°C.
Serve with washed salad and lemon. Discard leftover marinade that touched raw chicken; do not use it as a sauce.

en.title: 30-Minute Table Tennis for Two
en.summary: Invite a friend for 30 minutes of table tennis: a gentle warm-up, controlled rallies and short games. A playful way to practice coordination and reactions while spending time away from screens. Adjust the pace to your skill and fitness level.
en.imageAlt: Two adults play table tennis in a bright room with paddles, a ball and a green table.
en.sourceLabel: Killerspin – Health Benefits of Table Tennis
en.rightsNote: Original activity plan written for RANDOM life based on the topic of a Killerspin table-tennis article; steps and descriptions are not copied. The image was generated for this draft, not taken from the source. Editorial review of rights and facts is still required.
steps: Set up a stable table, net, two paddles and a ball. Clear space around the table, wear non-slip shoes and check the floor for hazards.
Warm up (5 minutes): march gently, move your shoulders and wrists, then practice small side steps without sharp changes of direction.
Rally practice (5 minutes): exchange slow shots across the net with your partner, prioritizing control and placement before speed.
Main play (15 minutes): play a few short games or keep friendly rallies going. Pause briefly for water and slow down if your form or balance deteriorates.
Cool down (5 minutes): reduce the pace, walk gently and relax your forearms, shoulders and calves. Stop if you experience pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness.
en.recommendationReason: Table tennis combines light-to-moderate movement, hand–eye coordination and social play. This original session offers an easy starting point without competitive pressure; health claims in the source blog have not been independently verified.

en.title: 12-minute EMOM
en.summary: Four three-minute rounds: fifteen squats, then ten to twelve push-ups, then eight burpees, each starting on its own minute. Rest for the remainder of each minute.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 12-minute EMOM.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. No external source or medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
At the start of minute one do fifteen squats, minute two ten to twelve push-ups, and minute three eight burpees. Repeat four times through minute twelve. Rest for the remainder of each minute.
Choose ten, eleven or twelve push-ups before starting. If no rest remains, reduce repetitions or scale the movement; do not carry unfinished reps into the next minute.
Air squat: move hips back and down, track knees with toes and stand through the whole foot.
Push-up: lower and raise the body as one unit with elbows angled slightly back; use knee support if needed.
Burpee: place hands down from a squat, move into a plank, return feet and stand; step instead of jumping to scale. A push-up is optional in this draft.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For structured pacing and repetition tracking. Choose a count that leaves time to rest and record any reduction.

en.title: Chinese Egg Fried Rice
en.summary: A comforting Chinese-style egg fried rice with peas, bell pepper and scallions. Turmeric adds a golden hue, while eggs are added in two stages for tender curds and lightly coated grains of rice.
en.imageAlt: Bowl of egg fried rice with peas, red bell pepper and scallions on a wooden table.
en.sourceLabel: The Woks of Life — Egg Fried Rice (Bill Leung)
en.rightsNote: Original wording is an editorial adaptation of Bill Leung’s recipe on The Woks of Life; source prose was not copied. Artwork was originally AI-generated for RANDOM. Review rights, facts and both translations before publication.
steps: Separate the cooked rice grains with a fork. If freshly cooked, let the rice cool briefly so it is not wet. Refrigerate previously cooked rice promptly and use it within a safe period.
Beat three eggs in one bowl. In another, beat the remaining two eggs with two tablespoons of water, turmeric and paprika.
Heat two tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Soft-scramble the first three eggs, then transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining oil and briefly stir-fry the chopped onion and bell pepper. Add the rice, separating the grains as it heats.
Pour the seasoned egg mixture over the rice and stir until the eggs are fully cooked. Add the peas and continue cooking until everything is heated evenly.
Season with salt, sugar and black pepper. Fold in the cooked scrambled eggs and sliced scallions. Serve immediately while hot.

steps: Razdvoji zrna kuhane riže viljuškom. Ako je riža svježe kuhana, kratko je ohladi da ne bude vlažna. Ranije skuhanu rižu čuvaj rashlađenu i koristi je u sigurnom roku.
U jednoj posudi razmuti tri jaja, a u drugoj preostala dva s dvije kašike vode, kurkumom i mljevenom paprikom.
Na srednje jakoj vatri zagrij dvije kašike ulja. Ispeci prva tri jaja uz miješanje, pa ih izvadi na tanjir.

steps: Suhe leblebije namači 12 sati u vodi, zatim ocijedi i dobro posuši. Za falafel ne koristi kuhane ili konzervisane leblebije.

Prži u manjim turama na 175 °C oko 4–5 minuta do tamnozlatne boje i kuhane sredine. Ocijedi i posluži s humusom.

en.title: Hummus with Homemade Falafel
en.summary: Creamy hummus and crisp falafel made from soaked dried chickpeas. Time includes 12 hours of soaking and chilling the mixture.
en.imageAlt: AI food photograph: Hummus with Homemade Falafel
en.rightsNote: Independently developed home vegan version; quantities and method are not a transcription of the linked recipe. No animal ingredients. Original AI photograph; editorial approval requested by the user. Use vegan-labelled packaged ingredients.
steps: Soak dried chickpeas in water for 12 hours, then drain and dry thoroughly. Do not use cooked or canned chickpeas for falafel.
Process soaked chickpeas, onion, 3 garlic cloves, parsley, cumin and a little salt into a fine, grainy mixture. Chill for 30 minutes.
For hummus, blend cooked chickpeas, tahini, lemon, remaining garlic, olive oil and cold water. Season.
Shape small falafel balls and test one first. If it breaks apart, process the mixture more finely and chill again.
Fry in small batches at 175°C for about 4–5 minutes until deep golden and cooked inside. Drain and serve with hummus.

steps: Warm up and review technique, especially swings and overhead movements; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Choose a manageable load, clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five movements in order, working 40 seconds and resting 20 seconds after each, including the last. Complete three rounds without extra rest between rounds: fifteen minutes total.

Kettlebell swing: grip with both hands, hinge hips back with slightly bent knees, then extend hips so the bell floats no higher than shoulder level. Avoid lifting with the shoulders or arching your back.
Goblet squat: hold the bell with both hands close to your chest, lower hips with feet stable and knees tracking toes, then stand with control.
Sumo deadlift: take a wide stance with the bell between your feet. Bend hips and knees with your back controlled, grip with both hands and stand; lower the bell gently.
One-arm row: from a stable hip hinge pull the bell toward your hip without twisting your trunk. Work twenty seconds per arm within the same interval.
Plank drag: with feet wide and one hand grounded, pull the bell under your torso to the opposite side with the other hand. Alternate hands and keep hips stable; lower knees if needed.

Keep breathing and set the bell down with control before switching sides. Rest when technique deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness. Extra breaks extend an interval session; in EMOM or AMRAP reduce work within the same timer.
en.recommendationReason: For someone familiar with swings and plank work. Select a bell you can control in the most demanding exercise, with a lighter bell available if needed.
equipment: Kettlebell of a manageable weight; lighter bell if needed

bs.title: 15-minutni trening cijelog tijela s girjom
bs.summary: Tri kruga po pet vježbi: 40 sekundi rada i 20 odmora. Zamah, čučanj, mrtvo dizanje, veslanje i plank drag povezuju rad cijelog tijela u 15 minuta.

steps: Prije početka zagrij se i provjeri tehniku, posebno zamah i pokrete iznad glave; zagrijavanje nije uključeno u navedeno trajanje. Izaberi težinu kojom vladaš, očisti prostor i koristi stabilnu podlogu.
Radi pet vježbi redom, 40 sekundi rada i 20 sekundi odmora nakon svake, uključujući posljednju. Ponovi tri kruga bez dodatne pauze između krugova: ukupno 15 minuta.
Zamah girjom: drži ručku objema rukama, pomjeri kukove nazad uz blago savijena koljena pa ih ispruži da girja zamahne najviše do visine ramena. Ne podiži je snagom ramena niti izvijaj leđa.
Goblet čučanj: drži girju objema rukama uz prsa, spuštaj kukove uz stabilna stopala i koljena u smjeru prstiju, pa ustani kontrolisano.
Sumo mrtvo dizanje: stani šire, girja između stopala. Uz mirna leđa savij kukove i koljena, uhvati ručku objema rukama pa ustani; girju spusti kontrolisano.
Jednoručno veslanje: u stabilnom pretklonu povuci girju prema kuku bez uvrtanja trupa. Radi 20 sekundi jednom i 20 drugom rukom unutar istog intervala.
Plank drag: iz širokog oslonca na stopalima i jednoj šaci drugom rukom povuci girju ispod trupa na suprotnu stranu; mijenjaj ruke i zadrži mirne kukove. Po potrebi osloni koljena.

Diši tokom rada i spusti girju kontrolisano prije promjene strane. Odmori kada tehnika popušta i prekini kod bola ili vrtoglavice. Dodatne pauze produžavaju intervalnu sesiju; u EMOM-u ili AMRAP-u smanji obim unutar istog tajmera.
bs.recommendationReason: Za vježbača koji već poznaje zamah i rad u planku. Odaberi girju koju kontrolišeš i u najzahtjevnijoj vježbi, uz lakšu girju po potrebi.
equipment: Girja primjerene težine; lakša girja po potrebi

en.title: 20-minute functional MetCon
en.summary: Four rounds of five exercises: forty-five seconds of work and fifteen of rest, twenty minutes total. This more demanding session includes jumps, a rotational push-up and plank jacks.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 20-minute functional MetCon.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. No external source or medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five exercises in order: 45 seconds of work, then 15 seconds of rest after each, including the last. Complete 4 rounds without extra rest between rounds. Total: 20 minutes.
Squat jump: jump from a shallow squat and land softly with bent knees; omit the jump if needed.
T-rotation push-up: after a push-up rotate into side support and raise the upper arm; alternate sides and use knees if needed.
Reverse lunge to knee drive: step back, return and lift that knee without jumping; alternate sides. This is not a single-leg pistol squat.
Plank jacks: from a high plank jump feet apart and together in small movements; step one foot at a time to scale.
Tuck jump: jump with control and land softly; reduce height as needed or use standing knee lifts without jumping.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For an experienced exerciser with controlled landings and supported rotation. Easier variations keep the timing without forcing jumps.

en.title: 10-minute core and stability
en.summary: Two rounds of five core exercises with forty seconds of work and twenty of rest. Split the side-plank work interval into twenty seconds per side.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 10-minute core and stability.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. No external source or medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five exercises in order: 40 seconds of work, then 20 seconds of rest after each, including the last. Complete 2 rounds without extra rest between rounds. Total: 10 minutes.
Crunches: lying on your back with bent knees, gently raise shoulder blades without pulling your neck.
Bicycle crunches: alternate bringing a shoulder toward the opposite knee, rotating the trunk without pulling your head.
Leg raises: lying on your back, raise and lower legs only while your lower back stays controlled; bend knees if needed.
Russian twists: sit with bent knees and heels down, lean back slightly and rotate your trunk gently side to side.
Side plank: support the forearm below the shoulder and lift hips; twenty seconds per side within one work interval. Bend the lower knee if needed.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For controlled floor work and trunk stability. Shorten your range of motion when lower-back control is lost.

steps: Warm up before starting the clock: 3–5 minutes of easy movement, shoulder circles, controlled squats, and a few easier pulling and pushing repetitions.
Set a timer for 20 minutes. Complete as many full rounds and extra repetitions as possible with controlled pacing and sound form (AMRAP).
Perform 5 pull-ups on a secure bar. Start from a controlled hang and bring your chin above the bar without uncontrolled swinging. Reduce reps or use assistance if form deteriorates.
Perform 10 push-ups. Keep your body aligned, lower with control, and elevate your hands on a stable surface if needed.
Perform 15 bodyweight squats. Keep your feet planted, track knees in line with toes, and squat only as deep as you can control without pain.
Repeat the 5–10–15 sequence until time runs out. Take short breaks as needed, and stop for sharp pain, dizziness, or unusual weakness.
Record full rounds plus extra reps. For a simpler option, use a 12-minute interval with 3 assisted pulls, 6 elevated push-ups, and 9 squats per round.
en.recommendationReason: Three straightforward movement patterns create a repeatable test of muscular endurance and pacing. Try the same format again later to compare rounds, while always prioritizing movement quality over your score.

bs.title: Cindy
bs.summary: Cindy je klasični CrossFit benchmark: tokom 20 minuta uradi što više krugova od 5 zgibova, 10 sklekova i 15 čučnjeva. Tempo prilagodi mogućnostima, bilježi rezultat i po potrebi koristi lakše varijante.
bs.imageAlt: Sportista izvodi zgib na šipci u svijetloj funkcionalnoj teretani; originalna generisana ilustracija treninga Cindy.
bs.rightsNote: Urednički opis i sigurnosne upute napisani su izvorno za RANDOM life, na osnovu javno opisane strukture benchmark treninga Cindy. Naziv i redoslijed vježbi predstavljaju činjenice o treningu. Fotografija je novo generisana i nije preuzeta s WODwell-a. Prava i tačnost podataka zahtijevaju uredničku potvrdu.
steps: Zagrij se prije pokretanja sata: 3–5 minuta laganog kretanja, kruženja ramenima, kontrolisanih čučnjeva i nekoliko lakših povlačenja i sklekova.
Namjesti sat na 20 minuta. Cilj je uraditi što više cijelih krugova i dodatnih ponavljanja uz kontrolisan tempo i pravilnu tehniku (AMRAP).
Uradi 5 zgibova na stabilnoj šipci. Kreni iz kontrolisanog visa i povuci bradu iznad šipke bez nekontrolisanog zamaha. Ako ne možeš održati tehniku, smanji broj ili koristi asistirane zgibove.
Uradi 10 sklekova. Drži tijelo u ravnoj liniji, spuštaj se kontrolisano i po potrebi podigni ruke na stabilnu povišenu podlogu.
Uradi 15 čučnjeva s vlastitom težinom. Stopala postavi stabilno, koljena usmjeravaj u pravcu prstiju i spuštaj se do dubine koju možeš kontrolisati bez bola.
Ponavljaj redoslijed 5–10–15 do isteka vremena. Pravi kratke pauze po potrebi i prekini ako osjetiš oštru bol, vrtoglavicu ili neuobičajenu slabost.
Zabilježi broj punih krugova i dodatnih ponavljanja. Za lakšu verziju odaberi kraći interval od 12 minuta te 3 asistirana povlačenja, 6 sklekova s povišenja i 9 čučnjeva po krugu.
bs.recommendationReason: Tri jednostavna obrasca kretanja daju jasan test mišićne izdržljivosti i upravljanja tempom. Ponovi isti format kasnije i uporedi krugove, ali kvalitet ponavljanja uvijek stavi ispred rezultata.

en.title: 15-minute kettlebell lower body and core
en.summary: Three rounds of five exercises with forty-five seconds of work and fifteen of rest. Includes shoulder-height swings, lunges, single-leg deadlifts, bridges and controlled seated rotations.
en.imageAlt: Original kettlebell workout illustration: 15-minute kettlebell lower body and core.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. The image does not certify technique or provide medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up and review technique, especially swings and overhead movements; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Choose a manageable load, clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five movements in order, working 45 seconds and resting 15 seconds after each, including the last. Complete three rounds without extra rest between rounds: fifteen minutes total.

Kettlebell swing: grip with both hands, hinge hips back with slightly bent knees, then extend hips so the bell floats no higher than shoulder level. Avoid lifting with the shoulders or arching your back.
Goblet reverse lunge: hold the bell close to your chest, alternate stepping back and returning with the front foot stable and trunk controlled.

Single-leg Romanian deadlift: hold the bell with both hands, hinge hips back with a softly bent standing knee and lift the other leg behind you. Work 22.5 seconds per leg; use a kickstand toe support if needed.

Glute bridge: lie with bent knees and feet down. Place a stable bell across a padded hip crease, secure it with both hands and lift hips without back arching. Use bodyweight if the bell cannot be positioned securely.
Russian twist: sit with bent knees and heels down, holding a light bell close to the torso. Rotate gently side to side through a small controlled range without jerking.

Keep breathing and set the bell down with control before switching sides. Rest when technique deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness. Extra breaks extend an interval session; in EMOM or AMRAP reduce work within the same timer.
en.recommendationReason: For a combination of leg work, balance and trunk control. Split single-leg work evenly; a lighter bell or kickstand foot support are valid adjustments.

steps: Prije početka zagrij se i provjeri tehniku, posebno zamah i pokrete iznad glave; zagrijavanje nije uključeno u navedeno trajanje. Izaberi težinu kojom vladaš, očisti prostor i koristi stabilnu podlogu.
Radi pet vježbi redom, 45 sekundi rada i 15 sekundi odmora nakon svake, uključujući posljednju. Ponovi tri kruga bez dodatne pauze između krugova: ukupno 15 minuta.
Zamah girjom: drži ručku objema rukama, pomjeri kukove nazad uz blago savijena koljena pa ih ispruži da girja zamahne najviše do visine ramena. Ne podiži je snagom ramena niti izvijaj leđa.
Iskorak unazad: drži girju uz prsa, naizmjenično zakorači nazad i vrati se uz stabilno prednje stopalo i kontrolisan trup.

Jednonožno rumunsko mrtvo dizanje: drži girju objema rukama, pomjeri kukove nazad uz blago savijeno oslonjeno koljeno i podigni drugu nogu iza sebe. Radi 22,5 sekunde po nozi; po potrebi koristi pridržavanje prstima druge noge o pod.

Glutealni most: lezi sa savijenim koljenima i stopalima na podu. Postavi stabilnu girju preko podstavljene pregibne zone kukova, pridržavaj je objema rukama i podiži kukove bez izvijanja leđa. Ako se girja ne može sigurno smjestiti, radi bez nje.
Ruski zaokret: sjedi sa savijenim koljenima, pete ostavi na podu i drži laganu girju blizu trupa. Rotiraj se malim kontrolisanim pokretom lijevo-desno, bez trzaja.

Diši tokom rada i spusti girju kontrolisano prije promjene strane. Odmori kada tehnika popušta i prekini kod bola ili vrtoglavice. Dodatne pauze produžavaju intervalnu sesiju; u EMOM-u ili AMRAP-u smanji obim unutar istog tajmera.

en.title: 10-minute kettlebell MetCon
en.summary: Ten-minute AMRAP: ten swings, eight goblet squats, six push presses (three per arm) and four burpees with a crossing to the other side of the bell. Rest as needed to preserve technique.
en.imageAlt: Original kettlebell workout illustration: 10-minute kettlebell MetCon.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. The image does not certify technique or provide medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up and review technique, especially swings and overhead movements; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Choose a manageable load, clear the space and use a stable surface.
Set a ten-minute timer. One round: ten swings, eight goblet squats, six push presses (three per arm) and four burpees with crossings. Repeat in order and rest as needed.
Stop at the signal. Score completed rounds plus repetitions in the unfinished round; each round has twenty-eight reps. The crossing after a burpee is not a separate rep.

Kettlebell swing: grip with both hands, hinge hips back with slightly bent knees, then extend hips so the bell floats no higher than shoulder level. Avoid lifting with the shoulders or arching your back.
Goblet squat: hold the bell with both hands close to your chest, lower hips with feet stable and knees tracking toes, then stand with control.
Push press: from a one-arm rack, dip the knees slightly, then extend the legs and press the bell overhead. Return to the shoulder with control; do three per arm.

Burpee over the bell: place a stable bell on the floor with ample clearance and keep hands off it. Perform a burpee beside it, then cross to the other side with control. The brief includes a jump over the bell; the safer editorial option is to go around it without jumping an obstacle. Each burpee plus crossing counts as one repetition.

Keep breathing and set the bell down with control before switching sides. Rest when technique deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness. Extra breaks extend an interval session; in EMOM or AMRAP reduce work within the same timer.
en.recommendationReason: For an experienced exerciser seeking a timed circuit. Score completed rounds plus extra repetitions; record going around rather than jumping and any other modifications.
equipment: Kettlebell of a manageable weight; lighter bell if needed

Zamah girjom: drži ručku objema rukama, pomjeri kukove nazad uz blago savijena koljena pa ih ispruži da girja zamahne najviše do visine ramena. Ne podiži je snagom ramena niti izvijaj leđa.
Goblet čučanj: drži girju objema rukama uz prsa, spuštaj kukove uz stabilna stopala i koljena u smjeru prstiju, pa ustani kontrolisano.
Push press: iz jednoručnog položaja uz rame blago savij koljena, zatim ispruži noge i potisni girju iznad glave. Kontrolisano vrati uz rame; uradi 3 jednom pa 3 drugom rukom.

Marinac preko girje: položi stabilnu girju na pod uz dovoljno prostora i ne oslanjaj dlanove na nju. Uradi marinac pored nje pa kontrolisano pređi na drugu stranu. Izvorna ideja uključuje skok preko girje; sigurnija urednička opcija je obilazak pored nje bez preskakanja prepreke. Svaki marinac i prelazak zajedno su jedno ponavljanje.

Diši tokom rada i spusti girju kontrolisano prije promjene strane. Odmori kada tehnika popušta i prekini kod bola ili vrtoglavice. Dodatne pauze produžavaju intervalnu sesiju; u EMOM-u ili AMRAP-u smanji obim unutar istog tajmera.
items.recommendationReason: Za iskusnijeg vježbača koji želi kružni rad na vrijeme. Rezultat su puni krugovi i dodatna ponavljanja; zabilježi obilazak umjesto skoka i ostale izmjene.

steps: Pat tofu dry and cube it. Coat in 40 g cornstarch.
Pan-fry tofu in oil in two batches for 10–12 minutes until crisp; remove.
Mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, tomato paste, water and the remaining 10 g cornstarch.
Briefly warm garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil left in the pan. Add sauce and stir for 2 minutes until thickened.
Return tofu and toss briefly. Scatter with spring onions and serve immediately.
Steam broccoli for 5–7 minutes and serve alongside the tofu.

en.title: 20-Minute Bodyweight Challenge
en.summary: A compact full-body workout you can do at home without gym equipment. Warm up for 3 minutes, then complete two rounds of seven exercises using 40 seconds of work and 20 seconds of recovery. Finish with a 3-minute cool-down and adapt the pace to your ability.
en.imageAlt: A person performing a squat in a bright living room with an exercise mat and plants in the background.
en.sourceLabel: Original workout inspired by The Daily WOD topic
en.rightsNote: Workout instructions were originally written for RANDOM life, inspired by the broad bodyweight-training topic on the linked website; this is not a copied daily WOD. The image was originally generated for this package. The source grants no assumed permission to reuse its images or descriptions. Editorial rights and wording review is pending.
steps: Warm-up (3 min): march in place for 60 seconds, then alternate shoulder circles, easy squats and hip mobility movements for 30 seconds each.
Main workout (14 min): complete 2 rounds of the next 7 exercises. Work for 40 seconds per exercise, followed by 20 seconds to recover and move on.
Air squats: stand about shoulder-width apart, lower with control as far as comfortable, then stand through the whole foot.
Wall push-ups: place your hands on a wall, keep your body aligned and bring your chest toward the wall. For a harder option, do floor push-ups.
Reverse lunges: step back alternately, bend your knees slightly, and return to standing. Hold the wall for support if needed.
Glute bridges: lie on your back with knees bent, lift your hips with control, and lower slowly.
Forearm plank: brace your abdomen and glutes, breathe evenly and avoid sagging through your lower back. Lower your knees if needed.
Slow mountain climbers: from a high plank, bring one knee toward your chest at a time without bouncing. Easier option: brace against a wall.
High-knee march: walk in place and raise your knees to a comfortable height, avoiding heavy foot strikes.
Cool-down (3 min): walk easily for 1 minute, then breathe calmly and gently stretch the front and back of your legs. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or unusual breathlessness.
en.recommendationReason: A useful pick when you have little time and no equipment. It mixes lower-body work, upper-body pushing and core stability in a simple routine, with easier variations to keep the session manageable.

steps: Zagrijavanje (3 min): hodaj u mjestu 60 sekundi, zatim naizmjenično kruži ramenima, radi lagane čučnjeve i pokrete kukovima po 30 sekundi.
Glavni dio (14 min): uradi 2 kruga od narednih 7 vježbi. Svaka traje 40 sekundi, nakon čega slijedi 20 sekundi za odmor i prelazak na sljedeću vježbu.
Čučnjevi: stopala otprilike u širini ramena; spuštaj se kontrolisano do ugodne dubine i podigni se preko cijelog stopala.
Sklekovi o zid: osloni dlanove na zid, drži tijelo u jednoj liniji i približavaj prsa zidu. Za težu verziju radi sklekove na podu.
Iskoraci unazad: naizmjenično zakorači nazad, kratko savij koljena i vrati se u stojeći položaj. Po potrebi se pridržavaj za zid.
Most za gluteuse: lezi na leđa sa savijenim koljenima, podigni kukove uz kontrolu i polako ih spusti.
Plank na podlakticama: zategni stomak i gluteuse, diši ravnomjerno i ne dozvoli da donja leđa propadaju. Po potrebi spusti koljena.
Spori mountain climbers: iz visokog planka naizmjenično približavaj koljeno grudima bez poskakivanja. Lakša verzija: oslonac o zid.
Marširanje s visokim koljenima: hodaj u mjestu i podiži koljena do ugodne visine, bez udaranja stopalima o pod.
Smirivanje (3 min): lagano hodaj 1 minutu, zatim mirno diši i nježno istegni prednju i zadnju stranu nogu. Prekini trening ako osjetiš bol, vrtoglavicu ili neuobičajenu zaduhu.

steps: Set aside a spoonful of chickpeas for garnish. Rinse the rest if using canned chickpeas.
Blend tahini, lemon juice and crushed garlic for 1 minute.

steps: Warm up and review thruster and pull-up technique with a coach. Select a load and movement variation you can control; prescribed weights are not appropriate for everyone.
The prescribed protocol uses 95 lb for men and 65 lb for women. Start the clock and complete 21 thrusters followed by 21 pull-ups.
Continue with 15 thrusters and 15 pull-ups, then 9 thrusters and 9 pull-ups.
Stop the clock after the final pull-up. Your score is total elapsed time, including rests. Record any load or movement modifications.
The card estimate is twelve minutes excluding warm-up; actual time varies. Prioritize technique, rest as needed and stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For a more experienced athlete who wants to track progress with a repeatable protocol. Record your time, load and modifications so future attempts can be compared.

en.sourceLabel: The Woks of Life – Sichuan Stir-Fried Potatoes (Judy Leung)

steps: Peel and cut the potatoes into very fine matchsticks. Rinse in several changes of cold water until the water runs nearly clear, then drain well.
Warm vegetable oil over medium heat. Briefly toast the Sichuan peppercorns until fragrant, then carefully remove the peppercorns from the oil.
Add finely chopped ginger, garlic and dried chilies. Stir briefly without letting them burn.
Add the potatoes and finely sliced fresh hot pepper. Increase heat and stir-fry quickly for about 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce, sugar, vinegar, sesame oil and stock or water. Season to taste and stir-fry for about one minute.
Cover for about 45 seconds, then uncover and toss with chopped scallion. Serve promptly while the potatoes still have some crunch.

en.summary: Warm flatbreads with an aromatic za’atar and olive-oil topping. The preparation time includes dough rising.

en.sourceLabel: Original recipe draft from user brief
en.rightsNote: Original untested home-recipe draft inspired by the user-provided dish list; not extracted from the named websites. Quantities, timings, safety and allergens require human review. Image is an original AI editorial illustration.
steps: Mix flour, yeast, sugar and salt. Add water and 20 ml oil, then knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and leave in a warm place for about 60 minutes, until visibly risen.
Mix the za’atar with the remaining 60 ml oil. Heat the oven to 230°C and preheat a baking tray.
Divide the dough into four pieces. Roll into flat rounds and spread with the za’atar mixture, leaving a narrow edge.
Bake on baking paper on the hot tray for 10–15 minutes, until the bases are cooked and edges golden. Serve warm.

en.title: 15-minute bodyweight upper body
en.summary: Three rounds of five bodyweight exercises: forty seconds of work and twenty of rest. Push-ups and plank variations alternate with a prone exercise.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 15-minute bodyweight upper body.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. No external source or medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five exercises in order: 40 seconds of work, then 20 seconds of rest after each, including the last. Complete 3 rounds without extra rest between rounds. Total: 15 minutes.
Push-up: lower and raise the body as one unit with elbows angled slightly back; use knee support if needed.
Pike push-up: with hips raised, bend elbows and lower your head under control toward the space between hands; reduce depth if needed.
Shoulder taps: from a high plank alternate touching the opposite shoulder, widen feet for stability and keep hips quiet.
Superman: lying face down, lift arms and legs slightly without throwing your head back; avoid excessive back arching.
Plank up-downs: move from forearms to hands and back, alternating the leading arm; use knee support if needed.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For someone comfortable with hand-supported exercise. Alternate the leading arm and use easier variations to maintain control.

en.title: Chinese Tomato and Egg Stir-fry (Fanqie Chao Dan)
en.summary: A comforting Chinese home-style stir-fry combining tender eggs, juicy tomatoes, scallions, and a lightly sweet-tangy sauce. It comes together in about ten minutes and pairs well with steamed rice.
en.imageAlt: Soft golden scrambled eggs and juicy red tomato wedges topped with chopped scallions in a ceramic bowl.
en.sourceLabel: The Woks of Life – Chinese Tomato Egg Stir-fry
en.rightsNote: Editorially rewritten and adapted from Sarah Leung’s public recipe on The Woks of Life; neither the original text nor photos were copied. The illustration was generated for RANDOM. Review facts and rights before publication.
steps: Cut the tomatoes into small wedges and finely chop the scallion.
Beat the eggs with ¼ teaspoon salt, white pepper, sesame oil, and Shaoxing wine.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Softly scramble the eggs, then transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining tablespoon of oil, turn up the heat, and stir-fry the tomatoes and scallion for about one minute.
Add the sugar, remaining salt, and 60 ml water. Return the eggs, fold together gently, and cover for 1–2 minutes.
Uncover and cook briefly until the sauce thickens slightly. Serve warm, optionally over cooked rice (not included in the ingredients).

en.title: 15-minute no-jump workout
en.summary: Three rounds of five no-jump exercises: forty-five seconds of work and fifteen of rest. Includes standing movements and slow mountain climbers; no jumping does not mean no joint loading.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 15-minute no-jump workout.

steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five exercises in order: 45 seconds of work, then 15 seconds of rest after each, including the last. Complete 3 rounds without extra rest between rounds. Total: 15 minutes.
Step jacks: step sideways while raising arms, return and switch sides without jumping.
Squat and punch: perform a controlled squat, then extend one arm forward while standing without locking the elbow; alternate arms.
Standing knee-to-elbow: bring opposite knee and elbow toward each other diagonally with controlled posture.
Lateral lunge: step sideways, bend the stepping knee and move hips back, then return; alternate sides.
Slow mountain climbers: from a high plank slowly bring one knee then the other toward your chest without jumping.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For home exercise when you want to avoid jump landings. Adjust step length and range; use a higher secure hand support if needed.

steps: Heat the oven to 175°C (350°F). Fit the pastry into a deep round pie dish, prick with a fork and chill in the freezer for about 30 minutes.
Line with baking paper, add pie weights or dried beans and blind-bake for about 35–40 minutes until lightly golden. Remove weights and paper, then brush the inside with beaten egg white.
Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet until crisp. Remove it, then soften and lightly caramelize the diced onion in the rendered fat.
Whisk four eggs with the milk-and-cream mixture, salt, pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Fold in grated cheese, bacon and onion.
Pour into the prebaked shell and bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 50–55 minutes, until the center is just set.
Rest for 10–15 minutes. Scatter parsley or chives over the top if desired and cut into eight slices.
ingredientNames: Equal-parts whole milk and heavy cream
Egg white for brushing the crust

en.title: Kettlebell strength pyramid — about 15 minutes
en.summary: Follow 10–8–6–4–2–2–4–6–8–10 across four exercises, resting as needed. Two bells are needed for gorilla rows. Fifteen minutes is only an estimate; both steps of two are retained.
en.imageAlt: Original kettlebell workout illustration: Kettlebell strength pyramid — about 15 minutes.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. The image does not certify technique or provide medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up and review technique, especially swings and overhead movements; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Choose a manageable load, clear the space and use a stable surface.
At each number in 10–8–6–4–2–2–4–6–8–10 complete all four exercises in order before moving to the next number. The thruster and high pull here use two hands on one bell.

Gorilla rows count total alternating pulls: ten means five per arm, two means one per arm. Split halos equally by direction. Totals are sixty per exercise; rows thirty per arm and halos thirty per direction.
Rest as needed. About fifteen minutes is an estimate without a fixed time cap; do not rush technique. Record any reduction to the sequence or load.
Thruster: hold one bell with both hands at the chest, squat and drive from standing into an overhead press, then return to the chest. Keep the trunk controlled.

Gorilla row: place two bells between your feet, take a stable hinge and alternate rowing one then the other, returning each to the floor. Each individual pull counts as one repetition; the pyramid count is the total for both arms.
High pull: hold one light bell with both hands, drive from the hips and draw it close toward the lower chest. Do not pull to the chin or raise elbows above shoulders. Lower with control.

Halo: hold a light bell with both hands by the sides of the handle and circle slowly around your head without moving the trunk. Split the prescribed count equally between directions; one full circle is one repetition.

Keep breathing and set the bell down with control before switching sides. Rest when technique deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness. Extra breaks extend an interval session; in EMOM or AMRAP reduce work within the same timer.
en.recommendationReason: For an experienced exerciser prepared for higher volume and overhead movements. Each exercise totals sixty repetitions, with arms and directions split evenly.
equipment: Two kettlebells for gorilla rows; lighter bell for halos and presses if needed

bs.title: Piramida snage s girjama — oko 15 minuta
bs.summary: Za četiri vježbe prati niz 10–8–6–4–2–2–4–6–8–10 uz odmor po potrebi. Potrebne su dvije girje za gorilla row. Petnaest minuta je približna procjena; oba koraka od 2 ostaju u planu.

steps: Prije početka zagrij se i provjeri tehniku, posebno zamah i pokrete iznad glave; zagrijavanje nije uključeno u navedeno trajanje. Izaberi težinu kojom vladaš, očisti prostor i koristi stabilnu podlogu.
Za svaki broj u nizu 10–8–6–4–2–2–4–6–8–10 uradi sve četiri vježbe navedenim redoslijedom, pa pređi na naredni broj. Thruster i visoko povlačenje ovdje su dvoručni s jednom girjom.
Gorilla row broji ukupna naizmjenična povlačenja: 10 znači 5 po ruci, a 2 znači 1 po ruci. Halo podijeli napola po smjerovima. Ukupno je 60 svake vježbe; veslanje 30 po ruci i halo 30 po smjeru.
Odmaraj po potrebi. Oko 15 minuta je procjena, bez fiksnog vremenskog limita; ne ubrzavaj na račun tehnike. Zabilježi svako smanjenje niza ili težine.
Thruster: drži jednu girju objema rukama uz prsa, uradi čučanj pa iz ustajanja nastavi u potisak iznad glave; vrati je uz prsa. Zadrži kontrolu trupa.

Gorilla row: postavi dvije girje između stopala, zauzmi stabilan pretklon i naizmjenično veslaj jednom pa drugom, vraćajući girju na pod. Svako pojedinačno povlačenje je jedno ponavljanje; broj u piramidi je zbir obje ruke.
Visoko povlačenje: drži jednu laganu girju objema rukama, pokreni je iz kukova i povuci uz tijelo prema donjem dijelu prsa. Ne vuci do brade; laktove ne diži iznad ramena. Spusti kontrolisano.

Halo: drži laganu girju objema rukama za bočne dijelove ručke i polako kruži oko glave bez pomjeranja trupa. Polovinu zadanog broja uradi u jednom smjeru, polovinu u drugom; pun krug je jedno ponavljanje.

Diši tokom rada i spusti girju kontrolisano prije promjene strane. Odmori kada tehnika popušta i prekini kod bola ili vrtoglavice. Dodatne pauze produžavaju intervalnu sesiju; u EMOM-u ili AMRAP-u smanji obim unutar istog tajmera.
bs.recommendationReason: Za iskusnijeg vježbača spremnog na veći volumen i pokrete iznad glave. Ukupno je 60 ponavljanja svake vježbe, uz ravnomjernu raspodjelu ruku i smjerova.
equipment: Dvije girje za gorilla row; lakša girja za halo i potiske po potrebi

steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
For each number in 10–8–6–4–2–2–4–6–8–10 complete squats, push-ups, sit-ups and reverse lunges in that order. Finish all four before moving to the next number.
Count lunges per leg: at ten, do ten left and ten right. Totals are sixty squats, sixty push-ups, sixty sit-ups and sixty lunges per leg (120 lunges overall).
Rest as needed. Fifteen minutes is only an estimate; do not rush technique to meet it. Record any reduction to the sequence or repetition count.
Air squat: move hips back and down, track knees with toes and stand through the whole foot.
Push-up: lower and raise the body as one unit with elbows angled slightly back; use knee support if needed.
Sit-ups: from lying with bent knees raise your trunk under control without jerking or pulling your neck; use a short crunch if needed.
Reverse lunges: alternate stepping back, lowering within a comfortable range and returning to standing.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For someone prepared for a higher total volume. The plan has sixty repetitions per exercise and sixty lunges per leg; rest and duration depend on your pace.

steps: Before starting, warm up gently and check your exercise technique. The warm-up is additional to the original nineteen-minute protocol.
Set the timer: each block has eight rounds of twenty seconds of work and ten seconds of rest, lasting four minutes. Add one minute of rest between blocks.
From 0:00 to 4:00, perform burpees for twenty seconds, then rest for ten seconds, eight times. Rest until 5:00.
From 5:00 to 9:00, perform lunges using the same interval pattern, eight times. Rest until 10:00.
From 10:00 to 14:00, perform sit-ups using the same interval pattern, eight times. Rest until 15:00.
From 15:00 to 19:00, perform air squats using the same interval pattern, eight times.
Your score is the total repetitions across all four blocks before the nineteen-minute clock stops. No target repetition count is prescribed.
Keep movements controlled and slow down when technique deteriorates. Agree any movement modifications with a coach and record them with the score. Stop if you experience pain or dizziness.
en.recommendationReason: For a more experienced exerciser seeking a structured workout without weights and a score based on total repetitions. Match your pace to your technique; a higher count should not take priority over controlled movement.

steps: Heat the oven to 230°C. Prick the eggplants and place on a lined tray.
Roast for 35–45 minutes, turning once, until collapsed and the flesh is completely soft.
Cool enough to handle. Scoop out the flesh and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes.
Mash with tahini, lemon juice and crushed garlic. Season to taste and adjust the texture without making it watery.
Spoon into a dish; add olive oil, chopped parsley and pomegranate seeds. Serve warm or chilled.

en.title: 12-minute kettlebell EMOM
en.summary: Four three-minute rounds: fifteen to twenty swings, ten clean-and-press repetitions (five per arm), then twelve goblet squats. Start each movement on its minute and rest for the remainder.
en.imageAlt: Original kettlebell workout illustration: 12-minute kettlebell EMOM.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. The image does not certify technique or provide medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up and review technique, especially swings and overhead movements; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Choose a manageable load, clear the space and use a stable surface.

Minute one: fifteen to twenty swings; minute two: ten clean-and-press repetitions, five per arm; minute three: twelve goblet squats. Start on the minute and rest for the remainder. Repeat four times through minute twelve.
Choose the swing count before starting. If no rest remains, reduce repetitions or load; do not carry unfinished reps into the next minute.

Kettlebell swing: grip with both hands, hinge hips back with slightly bent knees, then extend hips so the bell floats no higher than shoulder level. Avoid lifting with the shoulders or arching your back.

Clean and press: clean the bell into a controlled rack against forearm and shoulder without banging the wrist, press overhead without arching your back and return. One clean plus one press counts as one repetition.
Goblet squat: hold the bell with both hands close to your chest, lower hips with feet stable and knees tracking toes, then stand with control.

Keep breathing and set the bell down with control before switching sides. Rest when technique deteriorates and stop for pain or dizziness. Extra breaks extend an interval session; in EMOM or AMRAP reduce work within the same timer.
en.recommendationReason: For tracking pace and controlled repetitions. Clean and press requires practiced technique; reduce repetitions or loading if no time remains to rest.
equipment: Kettlebell of a manageable weight; lighter bell if needed

bs.summary: Četiri kruga od tri minute: 15–20 zamaha, 10 nabačaja i potisaka (5 po ruci), pa 12 goblet čučnjeva. Svaka vježba počinje na svoju minutu; ostatak minute je odmor.

steps: Prije početka zagrij se i provjeri tehniku, posebno zamah i pokrete iznad glave; zagrijavanje nije uključeno u navedeno trajanje. Izaberi težinu kojom vladaš, očisti prostor i koristi stabilnu podlogu.
Minuta 1: 15–20 zamaha; minuta 2: 10 nabačaja i potisaka, 5 po ruci; minuta 3: 12 goblet čučnjeva. Počni na početku minute i odmori ostatak. Ponovi četiri puta do kraja minute 12.
Izaberi broj zamaha prije početka. Ako ne ostaje vremena za odmor, smanji broj ili težinu; ne prenosi zaostatak u narednu minutu.
Zamah girjom: drži ručku objema rukama, pomjeri kukove nazad uz blago savijena koljena pa ih ispruži da girja zamahne najviše do visine ramena. Ne podiži je snagom ramena niti izvijaj leđa.

Nabačaj i potisak: girju kontrolisano nabačajem smjesti uz podlakticu i rame, bez udaranja o zglob, zatim je potisni iznad glave bez izvijanja leđa i vrati. Jedan nabačaj plus jedan potisak čine jedno ponavljanje.
Goblet čučanj: drži girju objema rukama uz prsa, spuštaj kukove uz stabilna stopala i koljena u smjeru prstiju, pa ustani kontrolisano.

Diši tokom rada i spusti girju kontrolisano prije promjene strane. Odmori kada tehnika popušta i prekini kod bola ili vrtoglavice. Dodatne pauze produžavaju intervalnu sesiju; u EMOM-u ili AMRAP-u smanji obim unutar istog tajmera.
bs.recommendationReason: Za praćenje tempa i kontrolisanih ponavljanja. Nabačaj i potisak traže uvježbanu tehniku; smanji broj ili opterećenje ako ne ostaje prostora za odmor.

en.imageAlt: Illustration of Mujadara
en.sourceLabel: Original recipe draft from user brief

steps: Rinse the lentils and rice separately. Thinly slice the onions.
Heat the oil in a wide pan. Cook the onions over medium-low heat for 25–35 minutes, stirring until deeply golden, not burned. Set half aside.
Simmer the lentils in 700 ml water for about 15 minutes; they should be partly tender. Add the rice, cumin and remaining onions.
Add the remaining water as needed to cover the rice by roughly 1 cm. Season lightly, cover and cook on low heat for 15–20 minutes, until rice and lentils are tender.
Rest off the heat, covered, for 10 minutes. Fluff gently and top with the reserved onions.

en.title: 10-minute mobility and stretching
en.summary: Two rounds of five exercises, sixty seconds each. The second round is an editorial addition to the user list so the session totals ten minutes. Move slowly without forcing range.
en.imageAlt: Original home workout illustration: 10-minute mobility and stretching.
en.rightsNote: Original workout from the user brief, editorially expanded and translated. Original AI illustration. No external source or medical approval; facts, translations and rights await human review.
steps: Warm up with easy movement first; warm-up is additional to the listed duration. Clear the space and use a stable surface.
Follow the five exercises in order: 60 seconds of work, transitioning directly to the next. Complete 2 rounds without extra rest between rounds. Total: 10 minutes.
Cat-cow: on hands and knees slowly round and extend your back through a comfortable range with your breathing.
Lunge with rotation: support a hand beside the front foot and gently open your trunk; switch sides after thirty seconds without forcing depth.
Deep squat hold: use a depth you can control with stable feet; use a secure support or a shallower squat if needed.
Cobra: lying face down, gently raise your chest with elbows bent; avoid forcing the lower back and use forearms if needed.
Downward dog: from hands and feet raise hips; knees may stay bent and heels do not need to touch the floor.
Keep breathing and prioritize controlled movement. Take extra rest when needed; this extends elapsed time. Stop if pain or dizziness occurs.
en.recommendationReason: For a quieter break exploring a comfortable movement range. Keep holds gentle and avoid chasing depth at any cost.

en.title: 15-Minute Home Workout
en.summary: A short, low-impact home routine to move your whole body without jumping or special machines. Seven timed stages combine a warm-up, straightforward strength movements and a cool-down. Adjust the pace to your ability.
en.imageAlt: A person holding a hands-supported exercise position on a mat in a bright living room.
en.rightsNote: An original editorial draft based on a short user-supplied phrase, not a copied external workout plan. The illustration was generated; publishing rights and suitability need human review.
steps: Warm-up — 2 min: march in place, gently circle your shoulders and swing your arms. Start slowly.
Chair squats — 2 min: lower your hips toward a stable chair, then stand. Move with control and rest as needed.
Wall push-ups — 2 min: place your palms against a wall at shoulder height, bend your elbows and press back. Keep your body straight.
Alternating backward steps — 2 min: step one foot backward and return, then switch legs. Use a stable support if needed.
Calf raises — 2 min: stand by a stable support, lift your heels and lower them slowly.
Bird-dog — 2 min: on hands and knees, slowly extend opposite arm and leg, return and switch sides. Move only an arm or a leg if needed.
Cool-down — 3 min: slow your walking, breathe steadily and gently stretch your calves, shoulders and back. Stop if you feel pain, dizziness or discomfort.
en.recommendationReason: A practical option when you want a little movement in your day but cannot get to a gym. Brief intervals, stable supports and flexible breaks make the routine accessible at different fitness levels.

Sklekovi od zida — 2 min: osloni dlanove na zid u visini ramena, savij laktove i vrati se. Drži tijelo ravno.
Naizmjenični koraci unazad — 2 min: zakorači jednom nogom unazad pa se vrati, zatim zamijeni nogu. Pridrži se za stabilan oslonac ako treba.
Podizanje na prste — 2 min: stojeći uz stabilan oslonac, podigni pete i polako ih spusti.
